ruleDefinitions.name: Communication To Ngrok Tunneling Service - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects an executable accessing an ngrok tunneling endpoint, which could be a sign of forbidden exfiltration of data exfiltration by malicious actors Note: Unmapped fields: DestinationHostname

sequences.query: (DestinationHostname = RGX(".*tunnel\\\.us\\\.ngrok\\\.com.*") OR DestinationHostname = RGX(".*tunnel\\\.eu\\\.ngrok\\\.com.*") OR DestinationHostname = RGX(".*tunnel\\\.ap\\\.ngrok\\\.com.*") OR DestinationHostname = RGX(".*tunnel\\\.au\\\.ngrok\\\.com.*") OR DestinationHostname = RGX(".*tunnel\\\.sa\\\.ngrok\\\.com.*") OR DestinationHostname = RGX(".*tunnel\\\.jp\\\.ngrok\\\.com.*") OR DestinationHostname = RGX(".*tunnel\\\.in\\\.ngrok\\\.com.*"))
